evals.prompt: Recap this morning's ops call and draft it to the team. Fireflies has it.
evals.expected_output: One unsent email draft in light formatting with the eight-section recap, plus a short TL;DR and the draft location in chat.
expectations: Invokes meeting-recap and fetches the transcript from the connected meeting tool
Creates exactly one email draft and does not edit it afterward
Every action item names a person
Does not use a heavy box layout for the recap

evals.prompt: Here's my voice-memo transcript from the drive home; pull the three best quotes for the newsletter.
evals.expected_output: Three quotes, each marked as a paraphrase, with one line in chat saying why.
expectations: Marks each quote (paraphrase) because transcripts from recording apps are often AI-cleaned
Says so in one line in chat
Does not present cleaned text as verbatim

evals.expected_output: The user's own session-end routine. The meeting-recap skill should not load for a coding session.
expectations: Does not produce the eight-section meeting recap
